bullets.title: AMZN hits $3T market cap, up 25% since last Wednesday
bullets.body: Amazon surged 4.6% to a new all-time high, crossing $3 trillion in market cap for the first time. The stock gained 25% since last Wednesday's close, driven by AWS posting its fastest growth in four years amid hyperscaler AI spending momentum.

bullets.title: Hyperscalers rally hard: META +6.1%, MSFT +4.7%, AMZN +4.6%
bullets.body: US hyperscaler stocks extended gains sharply, with META up 6.1%, MSFT up 4.7%, and AMZN up 4.6%. One analyst called this a 'violent shift in upside repricing' as the AI trade rotates from semis to data center operators. META has also recovered all initial post-earnings losses.

bullets.title: Hyperscaler CapEx on pace for $900B in 2026, $1.5T in 2027
bullets.body: Multiple sources flag that hyperscalers (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Oracle, Tesla, SpaceX) are tracking nearly $900B in CapEx for 2026. CSI estimates $1.5T for 2027. Morgan Stanley raised its global cloud spending forecast to $1.2T for 2027, up 30% YoY, noting all four major US hyperscalers remain capacity-constrained due to AI demand.

bullets.title: META and GOOGL invited to White House Tuesday to review AI framework
bullets.body: META and Google executives are invited to the White House on Tuesday to examine the White House AI framework, per Politico. The Trump administration also invited staffers from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. White House separately finalized details of advanced AI model testing protocols.

bullets.title: ISM Manufacturing surges to 55.6, four-year high; Prices Paid elevated
bullets.body: July ISM Manufacturing came in at 55.6 vs. consensus 53.9, a four-year high. Prices Paid remained elevated at 71.1. ISM respondents in the AI supply chain report positive sentiment while non-AI businesses show weaker conditions. Two respondents characterized current environment as worse than COVID-19.

bullets.title: S&P 500 Q2 EPS tracking 47% YoY; 19% from GOOGL/AMZN equity gains
bullets.body: S&P 500 Q2 EPS growth is tracking 45-47% YoY vs. 22% consensus, but a notable caveat: GOOGL and AMZN combined $151B in 'other income' from equity investments accounts for roughly 19% of total index EPS growth. Excluding these gains, underlying growth is significantly lower. DB raised 2026 S&P EPS to $358 and 2027 to $420.

bullets.title: SPY options: $1B+ call wall moves to 760; positive gamma dominant
bullets.body: The SPY $1B+ call wall moved up to the 760 strike amid 'relentless positive gamma' over recent sessions. Separately, a buyer continues accumulating SPY puts on rallies, suggesting some hedging against the upside momentum. S&P 500 Q2 profit margins hit a record 16.7%, though historically these are the most mean-reverting series in finance.

bullets.title: SPX approaching resistance; semis lagging; easy bounce may be over
bullets.body: The MarketEar flags that SPX is approaching resistance as the easy bounce phase ends, with semiconductors not leading the recovery and downside protection having been crushed. NYMO/NAMO bullish divergence that triggered the bounce is a rarely-occurring but reliable signal.

bullets.title: Tom Lee: S&P could reach 7800 in August; 2027 could be one of the best years
bullets.body: Fundstrat's Tom Lee sees a 'good chance' S&P 500 reaches 7800 in August, citing AI capex visibility, faster-than-expected inflation cooling, and S&P 500 2027 EPS up $15/share. Lee separately stated 2027 could be 'one of the best years for the stock market.'

bullets.title: PLTR earnings today: high-profile shorts vs. rapid contract growth
bullets.body: Palantir reports earnings today amid a battleground setup: high-profile short positions versus rapid contract growth narrative. Trading desks are sharing preliminary views ahead of the print.

bullets.title: DDOG 2Q26 preview: healthy channel momentum, Bits AI early, OpenAI moving to Anthropic
bullets.body: Preview notes for Datadog's 2Q26 highlight healthy channel momentum across enterprise accounts, while Bits AI remains early-stage. Notably, OpenAI optimization workloads are reportedly shifting toward Anthropic.

bullets.title: AMD warrant deals with Meta/OpenAI tied to 6GW Instinct GPU deployment
bullets.body: AMD struck performance-based warrant deals with Meta and OpenAI, vesting based on purchase and deployment of up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, with vesting thresholds tied to AMD share price. AMD has surged from ~$200 in early 2026 to $500-600, raising capital costs for AI infrastructure buildouts. At $600-700, GPU capital costs become effectively negligible for customers.

bullets.title: TSMC approaching 100K monthly 2nm wafers by end of 2026
bullets.body: TSMC is approaching a new production milestone with its 2nm process, targeting 100,000 monthly wafers by end of 2026, validating its advanced node manufacturing roadmap.

bullets.title: Smarter AI models could drive compute costs 10x higher
bullets.body: Commentary circulating that as AI models become more sophisticated, compute pricing could increase tenfold due to dramatically higher inference and training resource demands. DeepSeek's new model runs 100x cheaper than Anthropic's flagship, raising competitive pressure on US AI providers from the other direction.

bullets.title: AAOI breaks above 200-day EMA on strong intraday move
bullets.body: AAOI broke above its 200 exponential moving average, a bullish technical signal, while staging a strong intraday reversal. Traders noted AAOI, NBIS, and BE as names that showed stunning reversals after being heavily oversold and sold down.

bullets.title: AXTI positioned as world's largest InP substrate supplier with supply-demand gap
bullets.body: AXTI described as world's largest Indium Phosphide substrate supplier with high gross margins and ongoing capacity expansion. InP shortage is creating supply constraints, with demand outpacing available supply.

bullets.title: MU removed from Citi's 90-day upside catalyst watch on mixed memory peer earnings
bullets.body: Citibank removed Micron from its Upside 90-Day Catalyst Watch, citing mixed 2Q earnings from memory sector peers. NAND overcapacity concerns are also circulating for MU and SNDK.

bullets.title: Citadel warns Fed messaging is hurting credibility
bullets.body: Citadel Securities argues Fed Chair Warsh's policy framework is creating uncertainty by pledging to curb inflation without clearly explaining the mechanism, and appearing to rely on higher market yields to tighten financial conditions—a strategy market participants find unclear.

bullets.title: Tech IG bonds down 2.2% last month; yields at late-2023 highs
bullets.body: US investment-grade bonds issued by tech companies lost 2.2% last month, with yields rising to the highest levels since late 2023. The market is caught between interest-rate risk concerns and anxiety over AI buildout capital costs.

bullets.title: Open-source AI vs. frontier models: not zero-sum; both needed for $1-2T buildout
bullets.body: Contra the 18-month 'frontier models are dead' narrative, commentary argues open-source and closed-model AI are not zero-sum competitors. Closed-model revenues are essential to fund the $1-2T annual US AI infrastructure capex required, and both ecosystems are needed for American AI leadership.
